subject: Pilot acceptance passport + mutual action checklist
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novapath.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procurement@novapath.com>
Date: 2026-05-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Pilot acceptance passport & initial asks

Hi Mateo,

Thanks for the demo yesterday — team was impressed with the latency/cost profile. Procurement asked me to capture a short mutual action checklist so we can align procurement + engineering on what 'success' looks like for the pilot. High level asks from our side:
- Validation window: 4 weeks of production-like traffic (sampling)
- Latency SLO: p95 < 220ms for typical 256-token prompts
- Accuracy threshold: 92% on our 50-case medical triage prompt set (we'll share cases)
- Security: SOC-2 report + KMS integration confirmation

Can you send a one-pager or spreadsheet with acceptance tests, exit gates, and the suggested timeline (including dates for evidence handoff)? Procurement would like to see the MAP + an estimate of effort to run acceptance tests.

Also copying Procurement.

Best,
Jordan
Head of Integrations — NovaPath Health
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novapath.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-14T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot acceptance passport & initial asks

Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) that maps your asks to concrete acceptance tests, owners, and target dates. Quick highlights from the draft: 

- Acceptance tests:
  • Load verification: 4-week sample run with our dedicated inference pool; instrumentation: token-level latency traces and token counts.
  • Quality checks: we will run the 50-case triage set against the candidate model and produce a concordance report (92% pass threshold).
  • Security evidence: SOC2 summary (we have an in-progress report) and KMS walkthrough; security-evidence-checklist.pdf lists the artifacts we can hand off.

- Exit gates (fail-fast conditions):
  1) Average inference cost per request > 1.8x estimate for 48 hours (owner: account ops)
  2) False-positive rate on triage set exceeds 12% over a 24-hour rolling window (owner: ML eng)
  3) Any unresolved critical security control requested by your infosec for >3 business days (owner: security).

- Timeline proposal (high level):
  Week 0: MAP sign-off + PO in place
  Week 1: Staging verification (KV cache priming, end-to-end tracing)
  Weeks 2–5: Pilot sampling window (production-like traffic)
  Week 6: Acceptance report and go/no-go decision

Can we schedule a 30-min alignment call tomorrow to walk through the MAP? I can adjust the acceptance rig to run with your triage prompt set.

Attachments: MAP-draft-v1.xlsx, security-evidence-checklist.pdf

— Mateo
Solutions Architect | Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novapath.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-15T09:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot acceptance passport & initial asks

On Fri, May 14, 2026 at 11:05 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jordan — thanks for the clear list. Attached is a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP-draft-v1.xlsx) that maps your asks to concrete acceptance tests, owners, and target dates.

Couple of additions from a risk/ops perspective: 

1) We should include a lightweight smoke-test that runs prior to the sampling window each day (sanity prompt set of 10 cases) — this provides daily signal and reduces the risk of late surprises. Owner: Customer Success (Ben).
2) Add an instrumentation checklist item: token-level attribution logs retained for 14 days for troubleshooting during pilot (will not include PHI). Owner: Platform
3) Rollback trigger: if we hit any critical security control failure, we will stop routing traffic to the pilot cluster and fail to fallback model.variant-b (not the full fleet). Document the fallback chain in the MAP.

Please add these rows to the MAP spreadsheet and mark owners. Jordan — if that looks good I'll join the alignment call to run through acceptance evidence expectations.

— Marissa
Director, Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@novapath.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Procurement Team <procurement@novapath.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-05-18T16:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot acceptance passport & initial asks

Thanks Mateo + Marissa — this reads well and addresses our procurement and engineering needs. Confirming: 

- We accept the MAP as edited (please attach the final spreadsheet).
- Procurement will issue a PO by end of day Friday (PO #456782) — target Week 0 sign-off is next Monday 5/25.
- NovaPath will provide the 50-case triage set and the expected pass/fail annotations by COB Monday 5/25.
- We agree to the smoke test cadence and the rollback/fallback chain.

I'll send the signed MAP and PO to you this afternoon (signed-MAP-novapath.pdf attached). Next step: 30-min alignment on Tue 5/26 10:00am PT to confirm telemetry hooks and who will own each acceptance artifact.

Jordan
Head of Integrations — NovaPath Health
Procurement: procurement@novapath.com
